speaker: Agent
text: Thank you for calling HomeCare Appliances Support. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?

speaker: Customer
text: Hi Sarah, I'm calling because my dishwasher stopped working properly. It starts, but the dishes come out dirty and sometimes there's water left at the bottom.

speaker: Agent
text: I'm sorry to hear that. I’ll do my best to help. May I know the model number and how long you’ve had the dishwasher?

speaker: Customer
text: It's model DWX-4500, and I've had it for about 10 months.

speaker: Agent
text: Thank you. Since it’s less than a year old, it may still be under warranty. Before we discuss coverage, let’s try a few quick checks. Have you cleaned the filter at the bottom of the dishwasher recently?

speaker: Customer
text: No, I didn’t realize it needed cleaning. How do I check that?

speaker: Agent
text: Please remove the bottom rack and twist the cylindrical filter counterclockwise to lift it out. Rinse it under warm water and remove any debris. Let me know what you find.

speaker: Customer
text: Okay, I just checked. It was pretty clogged with food particles. I cleaned it and put it back.

speaker: Agent
text: Great. Let’s also check the spray arms. Make sure the small holes aren’t blocked and that they spin freely.

speaker: Customer
text: I checked the spray arms. One of them had some buildup, but I cleaned it. It spins now.

speaker: Agent
text: Perfect. Please run a short cycle to see if the draining and cleaning performance improves. I’ll stay on the line.

speaker: Customer
text: I just ran a quick rinse cycle. The water still isn’t draining completely.

speaker: Agent
text: Thank you for checking. It may be a drain pump or hose issue. Since your unit is 10 months old, it should be covered under our one-year limited warranty for parts and labor.

speaker: Customer
text: That’s a relief. What do I need to do to file a warranty claim?

speaker: Agent
text: I’ll create a service request for you. A certified technician will contact you within 24–48 hours to schedule a visit. Please have your proof of purchase ready. There will be no charge if the issue is confirmed as a manufacturing defect under warranty.
